newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Sun Microsystems higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Sun Microsystems higher.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc was trading at 28-3/4, 1/2 above its close on the NASDAQ National Market in a relatively quiet after-hours trading session, traders said Wednesday.
The company reported second-quarter earnings of $0.46 a share against $0.32.
Xilinx Inc was trading 1/8 up on its close of 37-3/4 after releasing third-quarter earnings of $0.33 a share against $0.41 for the same period the year before, one trader said.

Apple Computer Inc was hovering at the same price where it had closed at 17-1/4. The company reported a loss of $0.96 per share for its first quarter against a loss of $0.56 for the same period the previous year.
The New York Stock Exchange said volume for session one was 6,000 shares compared to 302,100 on Tuesday. It said session had 3,084,700 shares. There was no session two on Tuesday.
